name: Main Dining "Lighter Note" Chicken, Salmon, or Sirloin
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · All Main Dining Rooms
whyItWorks: Printed at the bottom of EVERY main dining menu across Wonder, Magic, and Treasure: plain slow-roasted chicken breast, oven-baked salmon filet, or grilled sirloin with steamed white rice or baked potato.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Your ultimate flare safety net on any night in any restaurant: order the Lighter Note Oven-Baked Salmon or Roasted Chicken Breast with steamed white rice or a peeled baked potato (scoop out the inside).
watchOuts: Skip the skin on the baked potato
Ask for steamed carrots or skip the mixed garden vegetables if flaring
